description:
## Goal

Give every delivered call edge one exact resume endpoint identity, and make the
shared resume entry consume the value layout already owned by its joined value.
No callsite may be selected by map insertion or iteration order.

## Proven defect

`required_resume_transport_positions` builds a plain
`HashMap<ControlEntryId, CallSiteId>`. Several callsites may deliver into one
resume entry, but the last insertion silently survives, so the required
`TransportPosition::ResumePayload` set omits every other incoming edge.

`lower_entry_origin` repeats the same mistake in the other direction: it finds
the first resume payload whose entry matches and imports that one edge's layout
as the layout of the shared joined entry. A non-tail `If` naturally creates the
shape by delivering both branches to one resume entry.

The defect is live when one branch does not return:

```fz
assert((if nil, do: panic(:bad), else: nil) == nil)
```

Interpreter, JIT and AOT all fail. The live nil branch reaches the join, but
the joined value receives a `nothing` layout when the arbitrary surviving
callsite is the `NoReturn` branch. The older example with returning calls in
both branches happens to print the right answer and does not disprove the
identity defect.

## Correct model

There are two different facts and both already have natural identities:

- `TransportPosition::ResumePayload { executable, callsite, entry }` is one
  incoming ABI endpoint. `callsite` is mandatory because it is part of endpoint
  identity. Emit one position for every structurally retained call tail whose
  destination is `Deliver(entry)`; every actual `CallReturnFlow::Deliver` must
  name one of those endpoints. A `NoReturn` call retains its empty endpoint but
  contributes no live value to the join.
- `TransportPosition::Value { executable, value }` is the shared joined value.
  `ExecutableFacts::value_origin(join.value)` already derives its
  `TransportOrigin::Join` from every delivered source. Require this position
  for every `DeliveredResume` entry and make backend entry lowering read its
  `value_layouts` answer explicitly.

`ResumePayload(None, entry)` is only an alias back to `Value(join.value)` for a
call-free entry. It is not a second join authority. Remove the optional
callsite and that alias path. `BackendEntryOrigin::DeliveredResume.layout` is a
`BackendValueLayout`; a joined entry owns a value contract, not an enclosing
function return/divergence wrapper.

This reuses the existing value-origin join, transport-position solver and
backend value-layout inventory. Add no join registry, folded any-callsite flag,
global scan, compatibility path or new semantic store.

## Strategy and deletion

Replace the arbitrary survivor map with exact per-callsite position emission.
Extend the existing local backend-position walk to include each delivered
entry's joined value. Delete the backend first-match resume lookup and consume
the exact joined `Value` layout. Make resume endpoint callsite identity
mandatory throughout transport ownership, telemetry and tests; delete the
dead `None` recipe and redundant alias round trip.

Do not resurrect removed `CodegenSeam` concepts. Prove the current retained ABI
return endpoints and backend deliver seams.

## TDD signal

- The reduced nil/NoReturn `If` succeeds on interpreter, JIT and standalone AOT.
- Required resume endpoint positions equal the exact set of structurally
  retained `(entry, callsite)` call tails with a `Deliver` destination; the
  two-branch reproduction plus its outer call retains all three endpoints.
- A deliberately asymmetric join proves endpoint layouts remain independent
  while the entry reads the joined value layout.
- Existing callable, tuple, ignored zero-width, recursive and receive resume
  cases remain green.
- Unchanged compilation performs no work; an unrelated edit invalidates none
  of these positions, and changing one incoming edge moves only its exact
  endpoint and joined value dependents.

Run focused three-door, transport, full library and serial fixture gates,
formatting, all-target check and strict Clippy. Remove temporary fixtures and
scaffolding. A fresh ticket-scoped cold review precedes one commit and close.

## Ordering

This ticket blocks fz-tfn.67. Selected-operand `and`/`or` lowers to the same
existing `If` join and cannot prove nil or an untaken raising branch until the
join and every incoming endpoint use their exact authorities.
title: Give resume callsites exact endpoint identity and joins their value authority
